host_rule: A6E4: second country unless result-kind set; else game host[calendar_class?5:continent(second)]; D44C compares host to second country

fields.meaning: Twenty little-endian player-index words; slots 1..11 are starters, 12..20 bench; order changes can persist.
fields.name: squad

fields.meaning: Unexpanded country bytes +28..29; no invented skill or lifetime assignment.
fields.name: unresolved_28_29

fields.meaning: Ordinary continental rank 1..32; country-rating/development/result-expectation input.
fields.name: continent_rank

fields.meaning: Ordinary world rank 1..128; country-rating and result-expectation input.
fields.name: world_rank

fields.meaning: Ordinary continent code 1..4; rating, venue-host lookup and competition/recovery routing.
fields.name: continent

fields.meaning: Eight Pascal-set defaults, modified/reset by setup/AI/manager paths; player overrides are separate.
fields.name: team_tactics

fields.meaning: Index into 3-byte manager entries; >128 means human-managed. Not itself manager ability.
fields.name: manager_index

fields.meaning: Persistent ranking/competition points; not the quick engine line sums.
fields.name: ranking_points

fields.meaning: Persistent historical/season totals; D050 includes a season block at +3B. Exact subfield types/lifetimes are not all resolved in this foundation.
fields.name: historical_totals_unexpanded

fields.meaning: D050 largest win/loss fixture-record area +77..A6; preserve as historical data, not player attributes.
fields.name: largest_result_records

fields.meaning: D050 home/away/all streak/current-maximum area +A7..BE; subfield enumeration remains reader-specific.
fields.name: streaks_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Side-0 score after play; pending marker such as FE/FF before play. Phase-dependent, not always a score.
fields.name: first_score_or_pending_mark

fields.meaning: Side-1 score after play; pending representation must be read with its phase.
fields.name: second_score

fields.meaning: Competition/friendly kind; 1 is friendly; gates budgets, fouls, results/deciders and venue.
fields.name: kind

fields.meaning: Played result: 0 side-0 winner, 1 side-1 winner, 2 draw; a silent decider coin may choose 0/1 despite equal score bytes.
fields.name: result_code

fields.meaning: Country for engine side 0; API first does not mean home.
fields.name: first_country

fields.meaning: Country for engine side 1; used by the venue-host equality flag.
fields.name: second_country

fields.meaning: Number of human managers at creation (ordinary 1..6).
fields.name: human_count

fields.meaning: Manager/selection flags and context not fully typed here; preserve them.
fields.name: manager_context_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Current fixture index used to locate the 8-byte fixture, not stored inside it.
fields.name: fixture_index

fields.meaning: Fixture-list count/context.
fields.name: fixture_count

fields.meaning: Includes the dummy/base host-table region; no further semantics assigned.
fields.name: host_prefix_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Five host-country words: continent slots 1..4 and slot 5 selected by the calendar-class flag.
fields.name: host_countries

fields.meaning: Year/cycle offset: initialised to 0; incremented by the yearly progression.
fields.name: elapsed_year

fields.meaning: Initial calendar-base year from DOS year+1 made even, not the elapsed counter.
fields.name: initial_year

fields.meaning: Stage byte in the competition cycle.
fields.name: cycle_stage

fields.meaning: Initial option byte 1; exact UI meaning not established here.
fields.name: option_3d_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Initial option byte 2; exact UI meaning not established here.
fields.name: option_3e_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Match speed/delay option; simulation determinism still requires the stated key discipline.
fields.name: speed_delay

fields.meaning: Initial year modulo 4==2 flag; chooses host slot 5 and stage calendar variant.
fields.name: calendar_class

fields.meaning: Other options, manager flags, pool viewports and strings within the 0x10E-byte allocation; not fully typed here.
fields.name: remaining_context_unexpanded

fields.meaning: Country association; computer entries start with their country, human entries use 129..134.
fields.name: managed_country

fields.meaning: Unsigned manager ability; 0AA7 reads this byte to compute floor(ability/8)+16. TEAM Skill labels also read it.
fields.name: ability

fields.meaning: Signed manager result-delta accumulator; B6CC adds and clips to -127..127. Distinct from ability and country rank.
fields.name: result_delta
